title: Guesty vs Hostaway: pricing, features and who each one fits (2026)
summary: Guesty vs Hostaway compared from their own sites: plans, pricing, AI, pricing tools, locks, owner tools and support, checked November 2026.
body_markdown:
**Guesty and Hostaway are the two best-known property management systems for professional short-term rental managers, and they're closer than their marketing suggests. Both are Airbnb Preferred+ software partners, both have a channel manager, unified inbox, AI replies, task management, owner reporting and an open API. The real differences are in who they'll sell to, how they price, and how much is built in versus added on. Guesty publishes a price for 1 to 3 listings and quotes everything above. Hostaway publishes no prices and starts at 2 listings. Facts below are from each company's own site, checked November 19, 2026.**


We make ProhostAI, and we integrate with both: ProhostAI connects to[Guesty](https://prohost.ai/integrations/guesty) and[Hostaway](https://prohost.ai/integrations/hostaway) and adds AI messaging and operations on top. Many of our customers use one or the other, so we have no reason to prefer either. Neither company reviewed this post.


## Key takeaways


- **Small hosts:** Guesty Lite (1 to 3 listings, from $20 per listing per month on annual billing) is the only one of the two with a published price. Hostaway sends single-listing hosts to a waitlist page.
- **Professional managers:** both quote. Get written quotes for your exact unit count, add-ons and contract term before you compare.
- **Built-in vs add-on:** Guesty sells pricing, locks, damage protection, payments and websites as named add-ons. Hostaway lists dynamic pricing, a direct booking engine and payments among its core features.
- **Both have AI:** Guesty AI suite and AI reply suggestions; Hostaway AI Replies and a newer AI CoHost.
- **Both are Airbnb Preferred+** in Airbnb's software partner directory ([Airbnb](https://www.airbnb.com/software-partners) ).

## Where we're coming from


We host in Hawaii, the Smokies and Joshua Tree, and ProhostAI reads reservations, listings and conversations from both Guesty and Hostaway accounts every day. Before ProhostAI I spent 6 years at Airbnb as a staff data scientist on the hosting team. The general lesson for choosing between two mature platforms: the feature lists converge, so decide on price transparency, contract terms, and how much of your stack you want from one vendor.

## Pricing


**Guesty** is the more transparent of the two at the small end. Guesty Lite has three published options: a "pay as you grow" offer from $9 per listing per month plus 1% per reservation (labeled limited time), annual billing from $20 per listing per month, and monthly from $29, with a 14-day trial and no card required ([Guesty Lite](https://www.guesty.com/packages/guesty-lite/) ). Pro and Enterprise are "get a quote." Guesty says costs are "set out before you sign your contract," and doesn't publish contract length or setup fees.


**Hostaway** publishes no prices. Its pricing page is a short quiz by portfolio size (2-14, 15-49, 50+ listings), and the "Only have 1 listing?" link goes to a page saying Hostaway isn't available for that portfolio size ([pricing](https://www.hostaway.com/pricing/) ). Setup fees and contract terms aren't stated.


What to do: ask both for a written quote at your unit count, with every add-on you'd use, the contract term, the notice period, any onboarding fee and payment-processing fees. Compare the total per unit per month over the contract, not the headline.


## Features that actually differ


### What's built in


Hostaway's features page lists the channel manager, unified inbox, AI Replies, automated messaging, dynamic pricing, AI revenue management, automated reviews, task management, payments, a direct booking engine, a guest portal, SMS and WhatsApp, and owner statements and portals ([features](https://www.hostaway.com/features/) ). Guesty's feature list is similar, but sells several pieces as named add-ons: PriceOptimizer, LocksManager, damage protection, Guest Pay and Websites ([pricing](https://www.guesty.com/pricing/) ).


That difference matters most if you'd use those pieces. If you already pay for PriceLabs and a lock app you like, Guesty's add-on model doesn't cost you anything extra. If you want them from your PMS, ask Hostaway whether they're in your quote.


### Owner and trust accounting


Guesty lists Trust Accounting among its products. Hostaway lists financial reporting, owner statements and owner portals; we didn't find trust accounting named on its site. If you hold owner funds and need trust accounting, ask each to demo it.


### AI


Both have AI that drafts replies. Guesty has a Guesty AI suite and AI reply suggestions even on Lite. Hostaway has AI Replies and has added an "AI CoHost." Ask each vendor the same question we ask everyone: which jobs does the AI finish on its own, and which does it only draft? Our guide to[what AI should run, draft or leave to you](https://prohost.ai/blog/what-ai-should-run-in-a-short-term-rental) has the checklist.


### Support


Guesty advertises 24/7 live chat; Hostaway advertises 24/7 phone support. If phone support matters to your team, that's a real difference.


## Who each one fits


- **Pick Guesty if:** you have 1 to 3 listings and want a published price (Lite), or you're a larger manager who wants trust accounting and a deep add-on catalog, and you'll negotiate a Pro or Enterprise contract.
- **Pick Hostaway if:** you have at least a few listings, want dynamic pricing, payments and a booking engine in the core product, and value 24/7 phone support.
- **Pick neither if:** you have one or two listings and don't need a channel manager. See[the best PMS for small hosts](https://prohost.ai/blog/best-pms-for-small-short-term-rental-hosts) for Hospitable, OwnerRez and Lodgify.

## FAQ


**Is Guesty or Hostaway cheaper?** For 1 to 3 listings, only Guesty publishes a price (Lite, from $20 per listing per month on annual billing). Above that, both quote, so compare written quotes with the same add-ons and term.


**Does Hostaway work for one listing?** Its pricing page sends single-listing hosts to a waitlist page.


**Are both Airbnb Preferred+?** Yes, in Airbnb's software partner directory ([Airbnb](https://www.airbnb.com/software-partners) ).


**Which has better AI?** Both draft replies. Ask each which jobs the AI completes on its own versus suggests, and test it on your own message history during a trial.


**Can I use ProhostAI with either?** Yes. ProhostAI connects to[Guesty](https://prohost.ai/integrations/guesty) and[Hostaway](https://prohost.ai/integrations/hostaway) .


## The takeaway


Guesty and Hostaway are both solid platforms for professional managers, with similar feature lists and the same Airbnb partner tier. Guesty is the only one with a published small-host price. Hostaway builds more into its core product and offers phone support around the clock. Above three listings, the decision comes down to two written quotes. Get them on the same terms, compare the total, and choose the one whose contract you'd be happy to live with.
